opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant - under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of costs (local community capital projects up to £30,000).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt/excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts. Not eligible: individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities. Schools, universities, medical research charities, hospices and counselling charities have additional criteria.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grant programme (open all year round, no deadlines) for grants under £100,000. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects (building works/repairs and equipment), and specific projects/activities across the UK in arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums & heritage, welfare and youth.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations. For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million (organisation income need not exceed £1m). For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Applicants complete an Expression of Interest form.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grant programme (Expressions of Interest accepted all year round, no deadlines) for grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects, and specific projects/activities across the UK in arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums & heritage, welfare and youth.
